summary: Iteration 18 · Full E2E verification of automatic trial + Stripe subscribe + subscription-success page + lightbox features. 11/11 backend pytest PASS + 13/13 frontend Playwright checks PASS on preview host. Consent-blocking is TRULY enforced (disabled attr + opacity 0.45 + pointer-events:none + text '🔒 Marca…' — clicking has no effect until checkbox is ticked). Trial license is minted as JWT (starts with 'eyJ'), duplicate email returns 409, honeypot 'website' returns 400, consent:false returns 400. All 4 Stripe packages redirect to checkout.stripe.com. subscription-success.html polls /api/payments/subscription/status/{id} every 3s and shows cancelled card on ?cancelled=1. Backend endpoint returns license_key/install_id/plan/expires_at/license_ready (null until webhook). Lightbox opens all 9 data-shot cards with correct medicarplus.es/screenshots/*.jpg URL and cursor:pointer. Mailer.send_license_email confirmed called (log 'Trial email → <email>: sent=True info=smtp_sent' for valid domains via IONOS SMTP; SMTP_FROM=info@medicarplus.es). v2.html app 'Millora el plan' button confirmed to hit same /api/payments/create-subscription endpoint.
critical_code_review_comments: TRIAL /api/trial/start — VERIFIED end-to-end: happy path returns {ok:true, license_key (JWT starting with eyJ), install_id (CD-TRIAL-XXXXX-XXXXX), plan:'TRIAL', expires_at (~60d), days:60, email_sent, download_url:github.com/Medicarplus/…}. Anti-abuse: duplicate email → 409 with Catalan/Spanish 'Ya has solicitado una prueba…' message; honeypot 'website' filled → 400 invalid_request; consent:false → 400 consent_required; malformed email → 422.

CONSENT-BLOCKING (CRITICAL user requirement) — VERIFIED at BOTH visual + functional level: (1) initial button has disabled attr, computed pointer-events:'none', opacity 0.45, text '🔒 Marca …para activar'; (2) clicking disabled button DOES NOTHING — Playwright click times out (expected because pointer-events:none) and no /api/trial/start network request fires + trial-success stays hidden; (3) checking [data-testid=trial-consent] triggers onConsentChange() which removes disabled attr + sets opacity:1 + pointer-events:auto + text changes to '🎁 Empezar prueba gratuita ahora'; (4) closing modal via [data-testid=trial-done] or trial-modal-close and reopening (via std-badge, prm-badge, or landing-trial-cta) properly resets checkbox to unchecked + button back to locked state. openTrialModal() function correctly calls trial-consent.checked=false + onConsentChange() on every open.

STRIPE /api/payments/create-subscription — VERIFIED for all 4 packages (STD_MES, STD_ANY, PREMIUM_MES, PREMIUM_ANY): returns 200 with url containing 'checkout.stripe.com' + session_id starting with 'cs_'. Unknown package → 400.

STRIPE /api/payments/subscription/status/{session_id} — EXTENDED and VERIFIED: now returns license_key, install_id, plan, expires_at, license_ready. Before webhook fires (freshly created session), all 4 fields are null and license_ready is false. Correct behavior.

LANDING STRIPE FLOW — VERIFIED for all 4 subscribe buttons: click → prompt('Introduce tu email…') accepted → POST to CHECKOUT_API with correct package_id + customer_email + origin_url → page redirects to checkout.stripe.com within 5-10s.

SUBSCRIPTION-SUCCESS.html — VERIFIED at 3 states: (1) ?session_id=cs_test_FAKE123 → MediCar Plus branded card visible, spinner running, 'Procesando tu pago…' + 'Comprobando (X/20)…' poll counter increments (reached 3/20 in ~10s); (2) ?cancelled=1 → '⏸ Pago cancelado' card visible; (3) missing session_id → error card. API URL uses location.origin so it hits the correct preview backend.

LIGHTBOX FEATURES — VERIFIED: exactly 9 .feature[data-shot] cards (main-cierre, irpf, contabilidad, libro-registro, estadisticas, sms-avisos, cites, auditoria, asesor-ia). Cursor computed as 'pointer'. Click on any card sets #featureLightbox display to 'flex' and img.src = 'https://medicarplus.es/screenshots/<data-shot>.jpg'. Cards without data-shot have cursor:'auto' (no pointer, no pill). Images live on GitHub Pages so may 404 in preview — that's fine, src is set correctly.

MAILER — VERIFIED via backend logs: 'Auto-trial created for <email>' + 'Trial email → <email>: sent=True info=smtp_sent' for valid recipient domains (e.g. brugulat.cat, medicarplus.es). For fake/invalid domains, sent=False with smtp_error 550 'mailbox unavailable / invalid DNS MX' (expected). SMTP_FROM=info@medicarplus.es confirmed in backend/.env. IONOS SMTP (smtp.ionos.es:587) is actively delivering.

APP v2.html — VERIFIED via grep: line 4432 in openUpgradeModal() correctly fetches apiBase+'/api/payments/create-subscription' → same backend endpoint as web landing, so app flow inherits the same tested behavior.

success_rate.backend: 100% (11/11 pytest passed — trial happy path + duplicate 409 + honeypot 400 + consent-false 400 + bad-email 422 + 4 Stripe packages + subscription/status with license fields + unknown package 400)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (13/13 Playwright checks passed — consent visual blocking + disabled click no-op + consent enabled visual + trial submit success with JWT key + prm-badge reopen resets consent + trial-cta opens modal + 4 Stripe subscribe redirects + subscription-success polling + subscription-success cancelled + lightbox 9 cards open)

test_credentials: None required. All tests use unique timestamped emails (TEST_e2e_<ts>@medicarplus-test.example) to avoid the 1-trial-per-email limit. Stripe test API key (sk_test_*) already configured in backend/.env.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create ~5 TEST_ prefixed trial licenses in db.licenses (unique @medicarplus-test.example emails per run) + 5 payment_transactions records (test session_ids). Small footprint, prefixed for future cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter18 is fully green. Any new tests calling /api/trial/start MUST use unique emails (append timestamp) — duplicates return 409 by design (anti-abuse). SMTP is LIVE (IONOS smtp.ionos.es); tests using @medicarplus-test.example (fake TLD) will show smtp_error 550 in backend logs — that's expected and does NOT fail the endpoint (email_sent:false but license is still minted and returned). subscription-success.html polls the SAME origin as itself (location.origin) so it always hits the preview backend when loaded from the preview host. To test webhook-completed status, need to simulate a Stripe webhook POST — out of scope for this iteration. Consent-blocking is enforced BOTH by disabled attr AND pointer-events:none inline style — bypassing either alone would still block; only removing both (via consent check) allows submission.
rca of the issue: N/A — full verification pass, no bugs. Note about test tooling: Playwright's page.click() blocks on dialog callbacks and can time out when a window.prompt fires synchronously; workaround is either (a) install a persistent page.on('dialog', …) handler BEFORE the click (never once) or (b) use no_wait_after=True + async task pattern. Documented in the test file for next iteration.
